name: pstack-refactor
description: pstack refactor: pin today's behavior → reshape by poteto-mode → blast-radius check (needs the pstack skills; they start more agents of their own)

steps.name: pin
prompt: Take the Refactoring playbook, steps 1 to 3 only. Learn the contract, then pin today's behavior with characterization tests, snapshots or an equivalence harness, and commit them. Write the target shape (module layout, types, call graph) and the structure it deletes to {{run}}/shape.md. Move no structure: the refactorer does.

steps.name: reshape
prompt: Take the Refactoring playbook from step 4, toward {{run}}/shape.md. Subtract first, then move in small steps that keep the pin green; migrate every caller and delete the old API in the same change. Don't touch the pin's tests or {{run}}/. Prove behavior is unchanged on the real artifact, and commit in order: subtraction, reshape, cleanup. Skip Opening a PR.
again: Fix each, or show why behavior is unchanged. Keep the pin green, and commit.

steps.name: check
steps.label: blast radius
prompt: This change must not change behavior. Read {{run}}/shape.md and git diff {{base}}, uncommitted work included. Find what it could break beyond the diff (callers named in strings, docs, config, other packages) and prove it by running code. Say too whether it lowers reader load. Change no file in this worktree. A proven change in behavior means CHANGES.
again: The refactorer has worked through your findings. Check git diff {{base}} again: is behavior still unchanged? A proven change means CHANGES.
